name: Mini Minecraft
one_liner: A kid-friendly, browser-based mini Minecraft — walk, jump, build and break colorful blocks in a tiny voxel world. Built for Hamza's daughter; local-only, no login, no tracking.
notes: Personal product for one known user (operator's daughter). Local-play-only by design; analytics deliberately N/A (kid privacy — no tracking of a child, nothing to hill-climb). Not part of the weekly GTM mandate; built on explicit operator directive 2026-08-01. Code backed up to a PRIVATE GitHub repo (operator-approved 2026-08-02; born private, never public — going public requires the full /publish-repo flow).
